name: Bebê
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL BABY Soulmonsters pre-evolution of the supplied own OPOSSUM KITE PUPPET reference, in exactly the same clean 2D manga flat-color finish. ONE tiny simple floating living kite head, no torso, no arms or legs, like a little paper opossum seed. Main shape a compact SOFT DIAMOND of warm ivory tensioned paper, charcoal triangular back corners, TWO broad ROUND black/teal paper ear lobes built into upper corners, small calm amber almond eyes with tiny charcoal brow strokes, very short honey-wood snout spar ending in a CORAL PINK nose, one tiny little smile. Two visible slender warm bamboo diagonal ribs behind head join at one CORAL knot under chin. Very short coral tail cord curled in one small loop from that bottom knot, ending in ONE small TEAL paper pennant. Exactly two ears, one nose, one tail; no puppet cross control frame yet, no strings around its face, no costume or hat. Gentle curious baby expression, face more simple than child, head not a rat or mouse with round muzzle; small tapered opossum face indicated by pointed lower diamond and little nose. 45 percent creature, 45 percent functional living kite construction, 10 percent crisp 2D manga outline, big clean color shapes and one hard cel shadow, NO texture, gradients, fur tufts, heavy detail, props, labels or scenery. Entire small complete creature centered on white with generous margins. Preserve family charcoal, ivory, honey wood, coral and teal.
story: Uma pequena pipa-rosto aprende a mover a própria rabiola.
review: Sem torso ou membros, dois lóbulos de orelha, um nariz curto e uma rabiola completa com um terminal.

name: Jovem
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL YOUNG adolescent evolution of the OPOSSUM KITE PUPPET Soulmonsters in supplied reference. Preserve charcoal, ivory, honey wood, coral pink and teal, clean precise 2D MANGA ink and hard flat cel shadows. Full body three-quarter pose on white with ample margins. Major anatomical maturation, NOT merely larger child. A lean elongated GAMBA OPOSSUM MARIONETTE beast with LOW HUNCHED semi-quadrupedal stalking posture, two VERY LONG slim articulated forearms reach forward and two powerful folded digitigrade hind legs support behind, narrow waist and long angular paper sternum. Four distinct limbs total, hands with FOUR slender coral-tipped fingers each, feet three pale claws. Head small relative to shoulders, triangular cream opossum face with dark slanted eye wedges and narrow amber eyes, LARGE ROUND charcoal ear lobes with teal inner panels, shrewd serious mouth with one small canine, honey wood telescopic snout ending coral nose. The head is still an ANIMAL opossum, not a human face or a rat, no humanoid armor helmet yet. Warm wooden limb spars exposed at joints, slim gunmetal/charcoal paper SHELLS fold over upper limbs and shins, coral knot hinges clearly visible, no modern machinery. Deep IVORY torso kite membrane uses X-shaped bamboo ribs braced at coral sternum knot and a small triangular folded theater opening low on belly, no clothing. TWO large TEAL paper shoulder panels fan backward into a half-open diamond KITE BACK FRAME, edged honey wood with coral corner knots; anatomical mantle is part of back, no floating extra face or extra head. ONE long coral prehensile tail originates at rump, curls high above back and grips a broad X-shaped kite-spar controller. Exactly FOUR taut thin gold cords attach cross frame to BOTH wrists AND BOTH ankle rings; route cords outside body contours, not across face, tail continues into two complete teal/coral paper pennants. The creature is learning to control all four limbs, an intermediate to a fully armored adult marionette with a detached hovering controller. Dynamic low balance pose: right forehand planted, opposite forehand lifted forward and fingers crooked, right hind leg stepping; negative space between limbs. Slightly larger shoulder and shin shells hint future dark knight without dressing a normal opossum in armor. Crisp dark outlines with a few selective steps, large smooth paper facets, one hard shadow per material. No gradients, texture, photorealistic fur, crumpled paper, busy tiny folds, spikes, titles, stage labels, extra characters or scenery.
story: Controla braços e pernas pelos fios; a membrana dorsal antecipa a pipa que ficará suspensa no adulto.
review: Dois braços longos e duas pernas dobradas; armação dorsal integrada, uma cauda contínua segurando cruzeta e dois terminais. Alguns fios mudam de direção nas mãos; conferir percursos em vistas futuras. Dedos visíveis parcialmente sobrepostos.

name: Adulto
prompt: Create ONE ORIGINAL ADULT Soulmonsters evolution of the supplied OPOSSUM KITE PUPPET creature, with the supplied own jaguar knight reference ONLY defining the helmet rule and clean manga maturity, NOT its armor design, colors or species. Full composition on WHITE, entire feet and floating kite visible, generous margins. ONE creature identity composed of a tall lean imposing HUMANOID ARMORED KNIGHT BELOW and its own OPOSSUM-SHAPED LIVING KITE hovering ABOVE manipulating the knight through strings. Vertical composition: kite takes upper quarter, knight lower two thirds with open air gap. Adult proportions eight heads tall, narrow waist, powerful long legs, two complete arms, two legs. NOT robot. Armor language is a DARK ROAD-WORN LEATHER AND STEEL KNIGHT: matte charcoal fitted flexible cuirass beneath angular layered gunmetal plates, high swept collar, asymmetric teal lacquer shoulder plate, compact opposite shoulder, ivory kite-shaped chest inlay braced by warm brass spars crossing at a coral knot, articulated overlapping abdominal strips, distinctive coral binding bands at elbows, fitted waist with two wide functional straps, segmented thigh guards and tall sculpted greaves with large diagonal plates, oversized cuff gauntlets and slender articulated dark fingers. Broad simple repeatable armor panels, few straps, no busy micro buckles, modern firearms, spikes everywhere or generic full medieval plate. Two long torn TEAL/CORAL tensioned PAPER COAT-TAILS from rear waist, structure of living kite not cloth costume. HELMET upper half is an angular OPOSSUM head mask: two large rounded black ear-shaped armor lobes, narrow amber slit eyes in dark triangular brows, ivory V forehead and a short tapered honey-brass opossum snout ridge ending coral tip above exposed upper lip. COVER ALL HUMAN EYES AND FOREHEAD. BELOW helmet only a mature HUMAN-LOOKING NOSE TIP, firm HUMAN LIPS and squared CHIN in warm tan visible, clearly no animal mouth or muzzle on lower face, no boy face. Helmet does not have horns. Above floats an unmistakable ORIGINAL OPOSSUM KITE with a stretched IVORY DIAMOND PAPER FACE, two rounded slate/teal paper ears, small sly amber eyes, short extendable honey-wood spar nose with coral end, charcoal panels and coral bindings. Large X-shaped warm wooden kite frame behind this face with four visible tips. Exactly FOUR GOLD STRINGS descend visibly and taut from the kite frame: two to knight wrist rings and two to small shoulder anchors, never intersect face. This upper kite is the creature's own puppet controller, not a second character or rider. ONE dusty coral prehensile soul-rabiola cord curls from the UPPER KITE's bottom knot and continues to two small teal/coral pennants beside the knight, its full attachment legible. Knight pose one bent arm raised with wrist softly angled like a puppet, other lowered open with deliberate adult poise; grounded firm staggered feet. Clean precise original 2D MANGA monster ink, flat vivid color areas, one hard cel shadow, selective sharp stepped edges. No realism, gradients, crumpled origami fur, logos, lettering, scenery, familiar costume or recognizable existing franchise character. Focus clever eerie self-controlled marionette knight silhouette and functional paper/spars/cord anatomy.
story: A pipa assume o comando de um cavaleiro articulado, mantendo uma única identidade e rabiola.
review: Pipa suspensa com quatro fios ligados a pulsos e ombros, rabiola completa com dois terminais, cavaleiro de dois braços e duas pernas. Elmo cobre olhos humanos; lábios e queixo humanoides expostos. Placas têm marcas superficiais mais texturizadas que a criança; simplificar ao produzir sprites. Sem outra alma na pipa ou no corpo.
